How the digital menu works

  • Add your dishes with prices and photos in the BeautyFlow dashboard (VAT-inclusive or add 16% VAT).
  • Download or print your unique QR card from “QR code & link”.
  • Customers scan → your menu opens in their browser, no app needed.
  • They tap “Add to order” and check out on WhatsApp, or tap the WhatsApp icon on any dish.

Why a QR menu beats a printed one

Prices change; printed menus don't. A digital menu is always current, shows photos, works in every language your customers' phones support, and doubles as your Google-visible menu page — so the same page brings in new customers from search.

Who uses it

Restaurants, cafés, bars, hotels, kibandas, bakeries and caterers across Kenya. It is free on the Free plan; Premium removes menu-size limits.
